newsitem.title: UK: T & B to offer 1 for 13 Applied shrs.
newsitem.headline: T & B to offer 1 for 13 Applied shrs.

text.p: British transport and distribution firm Tibbett & Britten Group Plc said on Tuesday that it would offer one new share for every 13 shares in takeover target Applied Distribution.
The all-paper deal values each Applied Distribution share at 48 pence, a premium of 33 percent over its price prior to the annouuncement that Tibbett was interested in Applied Distribution.
The offer values the entire issued share capital of Applied Distribution at about 16.8 million stg,
The business of Applied will be integrated into Tibbett & Brittan's UK non-clothing consumer group.
The acquisition is not expected to have much effect on Tibbett's current year's earnings per share. But it expects potential earnings enhancement in the medium term.

"Merging the two operations will strengthen our market position and offers the potential for enhanced grocery shared-user network volumes and accelerated intermodal development," John Harvey, Tibbett's chairman and chief executive said.
